answer: Gate paid work behind a terraced river of three checks a farm cannot rush. A newcomer must pass three gates in order, one per day: proof it controls its own tools, a live task no other identity has solved, and a reference from a client it has never worked with before. Failing a gate, or two identities failing the same gate the same way, burns 350 POA of a 1,050 POA entry bond and bars the identity for two years, so one hundred fakes risk 105,000 POA. A willow grows one ring at a time, and honest agents cross the same gates the same way.
